fieldNotes.location: Roster point (45.656846,-122.691343, geocode GEOMETRIC_CENTER) landed directly on the plant. Web research confirmed 4808 NW Fruit Valley Rd, Vancouver WA - a ~300,000 sq ft Frito-Lay manufacturing/warehousing/distribution complex (operating since 1972, ~460 employees). Street View confirmed a Lay's-branded trailer at the dock and tall black security fencing around the entire property.
fieldNotes.truckGate: The entire property is enclosed by tall black ornamental/security fencing seen in every Street View along NW Fruit Valley Rd; the dock apron is fenced off from the public road. Truck access is via a controlled gate, but the specific barrier-arm opening could not be pinpointed in available imagery. Classified truckGate true; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth resolvable. Given a fully fenced controlled property with an unconfirmed gate structure, classified remoteGs (gate, no visible shack). Flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long row of trailers backed into dock doors along the building's east face facing NW Fruit Valley Rd; ~25-35 doors estimated - the 25-50 band.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large trailer drop yard on the west side of the building - dozens of trailers in rows, 50+ stalls.
fieldNotes.railServed: Rail spurs are visible running into the property on the NW/west side; a major rail corridor parallels the site to the east. The plant historically receives bulk inbound. railServed true.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Main manufacturing-distribution building plus at least one separate structure (red-roofed building / outbuilding to the north); counted as 2.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Vancouver WA is part of the Portland-Vancouver metro; the site sits in a dense industrial corridor. Classified Urban.
